tagline: 佳能数码单反相机，2015 年发布
description: 佳能于2015年推出的数码单反相机。配备Interchangeable。快门速度30 s–1/8000 s and Bulb; X-sync at 1/200 s。

specs.快门速度: 30 s–1/8000 s and Bulb; X-sync at 1/200 s
specs.曝光测光: Full aperture TTL, 252 zones with 150,000 pixels RGB + IR sensor and EOS Integrated Subject Analysis (iSA)
specs.取景器: Eye-level pentaprism with 100% coverage and 0.71× magnification / LCD (Live View)
specs.屏幕: 3.2" (8.1 cm) Clear View II colour TFT LCD screen with 1,040,000 dots resolution
specs.存储: Dual slots: CompactFlash (CF) card Type I (UDMA-7 supported) and SD/SDHC/SDXC card (*UHS-I compatible),
specs.电池: Li-Ion LP-E6N rechargeable (1865 mAh), W-E1 SD card-shaped wifi adapter
